text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, when Furioso went out to buy groceries for dinner—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Customers
text_block_list.text:
""Hey, that bento is mine!"
"Please put a half-off sticker on this one too!"
"Excuse me, aren't you hogging a bit too much for yourself!?""

text_block_list.name: Furioso
text_block_list.text:
I completely missed my chance...!
My dinner is in jeopardy!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furioso managed to get a bento,
but she was worn out from getting jostled around in the crowd...
